properties.name: Heavenly Palace
properties.text: The Jade Emperor's court, where Wukong kept the horses, guarded the peaches and wrecked the banquet (ch. 4-7). Drawn on the Kunlun, the pillar of heaven and home of the Queen Mother of the West.
properties.text_zh: 玉帝的天庭，悟空在此做弼马温、看蟠桃园、大闹天宫（第4–7回）。投影在昆仑山：昆仑是天柱，也是西王母的居所。

properties.name: The underworld
properties.text: The ten courts of the dead, where Wukong struck out his name and Taizong pleaded his case (ch. 3, 10-11, 58, 97). Drawn on Mount Tai, which in Chinese belief governed the souls of the dead.
properties.text_zh: 十殿阎罗所在，悟空在此勾销生死簿，唐太宗在此对质还魂（第3、10–11、58、97回）。投影在泰山：旧俗以泰山主治鬼魂。

properties.name: Dragon Palace of the Eastern Sea
properties.text: Where Wukong took the gold-banded staff (ch. 3) and went to sulk after his first quarrel with Tripitaka (ch. 14). Drawn in the East China Sea.
properties.text_zh: 悟空在此取得金箍棒（第3回），第一次与唐僧闹翻后也到这里散心（第14回）。投影在东海。

properties.name: Spirit Mountain
properties.text: The Buddha's Thunderclap Monastery, the end of the road (ch. 8, 58, 98, 100). Drawn on Vulture Peak outside Rajgir, where the Buddha is said to have preached, a few miles from Nalanda where Xuanzang studied.
properties.text_zh: 如来的雷音寺，取经路的终点（第8、58、98、100回）。投影在王舍城外的灵鹫山，相传佛陀在此说法，距玄奘求学的那烂陀寺不远。
